svg.title: Patient shares selected data with a caregiver / doctor

g.text: Patient shares selected data with a caregiver / doctor
email + items [bp, spo2, report] + expiry 7 days
INSERT INTO access_permissions (active, expires_at = now + 7 d)
The permission stores EXACTLY which items are visible;
the patient can revoke it at any time.
SELECT access_permissions WHERE status = active AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW())
filter cards/summary to shared codes only
Revoked or expired permission -> all reads return 403,
enforced again on every request (defence in depth).
